METHODOLOGY • END-TO-END

Our Operating Approach

We manage the workflow, not just the task. When you bring an operational requirement to CubicEnhance, we begin by understanding what needs to be done and how the work currently operates. We then structure the workflow so responsibilities, processes, quality requirements, and exceptions can be clearly managed.

STEP 01

Discovery & Requirement Understanding

We begin with a secure virtual discovery meeting to deeply understand your operational requirement, the work involved, and the process that needs to be managed.

01
Requirement Scoping

Comprehensive intake of tooling, access levels, expected volume, and team bandwidth requirements.

STEP 02

Process Mapping

Protected by strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and confidentiality protocols, we examine your workflow to identify the inputs, systems, decision points, and areas where automation or human work may be appropriate.

02
System & Decision Modeling

Documenting handoffs, inputs, data structures, and identifying opportunities for automated triage.

STEP 03

SOP Development

For repeatable workflows, we develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to document how the work should be performed and managed consistently.

03
Institutional Documentation

Creating clear, audit-ready operating handbooks that eliminate individual dependency.

STEP 04

Pilot

Where appropriate, we use a clearly defined pilot to test the workflow, validate the operating approach, and demonstrate delivery capability before moving into recurring operations.

04
Live Validation Run

Low-risk live testing window ensuring zero disruption to existing business operations.

STEP 05

Managed Execution

Once the workflow is established, CubicEnhance manages the assigned process through its remote workforce, supported by AI and automation where appropriate.

05
Recurring Operational Delivery

Dedicated operational pods working to guaranteed quality standards and turnaround times.

STEP 06

Quality Control & Improvement

Work is reviewed through our quality-control process, with AI checks, human review, and supervisor oversight for exceptions and higher-risk cases. Process learnings can then be used to improve the workflow.

06
Continuous Optimization

Iterative refinement loop identifying efficiency gains, reducing error rates, and improving throughput.

AI-FIRST OPERATING STRATEGY

AI where it improves the workflow. Humans where judgment matters.

AI is an important part of the CubicEnhance operating model. We use AI and automation where they can support productivity, consistency, and the handling of repetitive work. AI may support activities such as document extraction, OCR processing, data classification, and routine information processing. Human operators remain responsible for verification, exception handling, and situations that require context or judgment.

Explore AI Workflows →
01

AI-Assisted Processing

AI supports suitable high-volume and repetitive stages of a workflow, helping process and organize information efficiently.

02

Human Verification

Human operators review outputs and verify information before it moves forward in the workflow.

03

Exception Handling

Unusual cases, mismatches, failed automated workflows, and other exceptions are handled through human intervention.

04

Quality Control

AI checks, human review, and supervisor oversight are combined according to the workflow and its quality requirements.

PRE-EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE

Structure Before Scale

Eliminating ambiguity through rigorous documentation and risk-free testing.

A

Process Mapping & SOPs

Before execution, we structure the work. A recurring operational process should not depend on individual workers simply knowing what to do. It needs to be understood, documented, and managed. We work to understand:

  • The inputs required to begin the process
  • The steps involved in completing the work
  • The systems and information used
  • Responsibilities within the workflow
  • Decision points and exceptions
  • Quality-control requirements
  • The expected output
B

Pilot Strategy

Test the workflow before scaling it. For suitable engagements, CubicEnhance uses a pilot strategy to establish how a defined workflow can be managed before moving into recurring operations. A pilot provides an opportunity to:

  • Define the scope of the work
  • Test the workflow and SOP
  • Evaluate AI and human involvement
  • Identify exceptions and operational requirements
  • Review delivery quality
  • Learn from the process before broader implementation
RISK & COMPLIANCE

Security & Data Protection

Controlled access to the information your workflow requires. Data protection is an important part of managing business operations remotely. CubicEnhance uses operational controls designed to limit access to client information and protect confidential business data.

Confidentiality

Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) are used as part of our approach to protecting client information.

Access Control

Access to information is strictly limited according to the requirements of the specific workflow.

Role-Based Permissions

Workers receive access based on their role and the information required to perform their assigned responsibilities.

Two-Factor Authentication

Two-factor authentication is used as an additional access-control measure.

Controlled Data Access

Sensitive information is made available only to workers who require it for the relevant workflow.
